draft_text:
LEGAL NOTICE

Date: [DATE]

To,
Mr. Suresh Sharma
456, Nehru Road, Nashik - 422001, Maharashtra

Sub: Legal Notice under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 for dishonour of cheque no. 123456 for Rs. 50,000/-

Dear Sir,

We are instructed by and on behalf of our client Mr. Ramesh Patil, resident of 123, Gandhi Nagar, Pune - 411001, Maharashtra, to serve upon you this Legal Notice under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, as under:

1. That our client extended a friendly loan of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) to you, which you promised to repay.

2. That towards repayment of the said amount, you issued Cheque No. 123456 dated 15/03/2024 for Rs. 50,000/- drawn on State Bank of India.

3. That when the said cheque was presented for encashment on 17/03/2024, the same was returned unpaid by the bank vide memo dated 18/03/2024 with the reason 'Insufficient Funds'.

4. That the dishonour of the said cheque constitutes an offence under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881.

You are hereby called upon to pay the aforesaid amount of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) together with interest and costs of this notice within 15 (Fifteen) days from the date of receipt of this notice.

Failing which, our client shall be constrained to initiate appropriate legal proceedings against you, both civil and criminal, at your risk and cost, without any further notice.

Yours faithfully,

[Advocate Name]
[Bar Council No.]
[Address]

⚠ AI-GENERATED DRAFT – ADVOCATE REVIEW IS REQUIRED BEFORE USE
